pairs.topic: babies learn to balance
pairs.en: Babies learn to balance as they grow, which is why they often fall down before they can stand and walk.
pairs.tl: Natututong bumalanse ang mga sanggol habang lumalaki sila, kaya madalas silang nadadapa bago matutong tumayo at maglakad.

pairs.topic: Hardness means scratch resistance, not toughness
pairs.en: Many people think a mineral's hardness is about how strong it is or how easily it breaks. But hardness on the Mohs scale is only about how hard it is to scratch.
pairs.tl: Maraming nag-aakalang ang tigas ng mineral ay tungkol sa kung gaano kalakas ito o kung madaling mabasag. Pero ang tigas sa Mohs scale ay tungkol lang sa kung gaano kahirap itong gasgasan.

Marami ang nag-aakalang malakas ang mineral dahil tigas, pero pwede pa ring mabasag ang matigas na mineral kung matindi ang pagsunog.

pairs.topic: torpor is short-term energy saving
pairs.en: Torpor is a short slowdown of the body, sometimes lasting only one night, that some animals like bats use to save energy.
pairs.tl: Ang torpor ay isang maikling pagbagal ng katawan, kahit isang gabi lang, na ginagawa ng ilang hayop tulad ng paniki para makatipid ng enerhiya.

pairs.en: A snail has a strong muscle attached inside its shell. When this muscle tightens, it works like a spring and pulls the snail's body back inside the shell.
pairs.tl: May malakas na kalamnan ang kuhol na nakakabit sa loob ng bahay nito. Kapag humigpit ang kalamnang ito, parang spring na hinihila nito ang katawan papasok sa shell.

pairs.en: More gas dissolves in a liquid when the pressure is higher; that is why a sealed soda bottle is kept under pressure to keep the carbon dioxide dissolved.

pairs.topic: cohesion and adhesion of water
pairs.en: Cohesion is the attraction of water molecules to each other. Adhesion is the attraction of water to other surfaces (like glass or cloth). Both work together to produce surface tension and capillary action.
pairs.tl: Ang cohesion ay ang pag-akit ng mga molekula ng tubig sa isa't isa. Ang adhesion ay ang pag-akit ng tubig sa ibang mga ibabaw (tulad ng salamin o tela). Ang dalawa ay nagtutulungan upang magkaroon ng surface tension at capillary action.

pairs.en: All objects falling toward Earth (without air resistance) accelerate at the same rate of about 9.8 metres per second squared (9.8 m/s²) regardless of mass.
pairs.tl: Ang lahat ng bagay na bumabagsak sa lupa (kung walang air resistance) ay nag-a-accelerate sa parehong rate na halos 9.8 metro bawat segundo bawat segundo (9.8 m/s²).

pairs.topic: Groundwater as a stage in the water cycle
pairs.en: Groundwater is one stage of the water cycle. After rain soaks in, the water slowly flows underground toward rivers, lakes, or the sea. That is why rivers still have water even when it is not raining, fed by groundwater.
pairs.tl: Ang groundwater ay isang bahagi ng water cycle. Pagkatapos tumagos ang ulan, dahan-dahang umaagos ang tubig sa ilalim ng lupa papuntang ilog, lawa, o dagat. Kaya kahit hindi umuulan, may tubig pa rin sa ilog galing sa groundwater.

pairs.topic: habagat brings the rainy season
pairs.en: The habagat is wind that blows from the southwest, usually from June to September. It carries moist, wet air from the sea, so it brings the rainy season to the Philippines.
pairs.tl: Ang habagat ay hanging humihihip mula sa timog-kanluran, kadalasan mula Hunyo hanggang Setyembre. Dala nito ang basa at mahalumigmig na hangin mula sa dagat, kaya ito ang nagdadala ng tag-ulan sa Pilipinas.
